model.name: Nifty 100 technical ranking
model.summary: Daily candles for every Nifty 100 stock are scanned for four technical setups (breakout, pullback in an uptrend, trend continuation, support reversal). Stocks with a setup are ranked by setup strength; stocks trading 10%+ below their 52-week closing high are listed after them as 52-week dips.
